title: Tip Calculator: Tip on Pre-Tax or Full Bill, Split Between People
description: Free tip calculator: enter your bill and sales tax, pick a tip percentage on the pre-tax amount or the full bill, and split the total evenly between up to 100 people.
lead: How much should you tip, and what does each person owe? Enter the bill, the tax and a tip percentage to see the tip, the total and each person's share, with the option to tip on the amount before tax.

sources.title: Emily Post Institute: Tipping Etiquette 101, A Comprehensive Guide on Tipping
U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division: Fact Sheet #15, Tipped Employees Under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)
